A systematic meta-analysis of genetic, regional, and production determinants of global pork quality

Code and model outputs - Oleic Acid

1 Loading packages and data

## load the packages
library(metafor)
library(orchaRd)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(kableExtra)
library(knitr)
library(openxlsx)
library(MuMIn)
library(glue)
library(rlang)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
## Load the functions from the script file
source("functions.R")
## Load the data for Oleic Acid
data_OA <- read.csv("OA.csv")

## Convert columns to appropriate numeric types
data_OA$Mean <- as.numeric(data_OA$Mean)
data_OA$SD <- as.numeric(data_OA$SD)
data_OA$Sample <- as.numeric(data_OA$Sample)
data_OA$Age <- as.numeric(data_OA$Age)
data_OA$Weight <- as.numeric(data_OA$Weight)
data_OA$Digestible_energy <- as.numeric(data_OA$Digestible_energy)
data_OA$Crude_protein <- as.numeric(data_OA$Crude_protein)
data_OA$Crude_fat <- as.numeric(data_OA$Crude_fat)
data_OA$Crude_fiber <- as.numeric(data_OA$Crude_fiber)
data_OA$Ash <- as.numeric(data_OA$Ash)
data_OA$Lys <- as.numeric(data_OA$Lys)
data_OA$Met_and_Cys <- as.numeric(data_OA$Met_and_Cys)
data_OA$Thr <- as.numeric(data_OA$Thr)
data_OA$Try <- as.numeric(data_OA$Try)
data_OA$Val <- as.numeric(data_OA$Val)
data_OA$Dry_matter <- as.numeric(data_OA$Dry_matter)
data_OA$Ca <- as.numeric(data_OA$Ca)
data_OA$P <- as.numeric(data_OA$P)
data_OA$Na <- as.numeric(data_OA$Na)

## Convert columns to factor types
data_OA$Position <- factor(data_OA$Position)
data_OA$Breed <- factor(data_OA$Breed)
data_OA$Class <- factor(data_OA$Class)
data_OA$Sex <- factor(data_OA$Sex)
data_OA$Region <- factor(data_OA$Region) 
data_OA$Aim <- factor(data_OA$Aim)
data_OA$Multiple_breeds <- factor(data_OA$Multiple_breeds)

## Calculate variance (rVar)
# rVar is the square of the standard error (SD/sqrt(Sample))
data_OA$rVar <- (data_OA$SD/sqrt(data_OA$Sample))^2

2 Testing random effects

## Run VCV matrix for all data
VCV_OA_AllData <- make_VCV_matrix(data_OA, 
                                   V = "rVar", 
                                   cluster = "StudyID", 
                                   obs = "RowID")

## Null model with VCV matrix:
# This model includes random effects for RowID (observation-level) and StudyID.
null_OA_mod <- rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_OA_AllData, 
                       random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                     ~1 |StudyID),
                       sparse = TRUE,
                       data = data_OA, method = "ML")
summary(null_OA_mod) #2844.6020            
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 462; method: ML)
## 
##     logLik    Deviance         AIC         BIC        AICc   
## -1419.3010   2455.6747   2844.6020   2857.0087   2844.6544   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##              estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed   factor 
## sigma^2.1   8.7671  2.9609    462     no    RowID 
## sigma^2.2  41.0324  6.4057    222     no  StudyID 
## 
## Test for Heterogeneity:
## Q(df = 461) = 297114.6971, p-val < .0001
## 
## Model Results:
## 
## estimate      se     zval    pval    ci.lb    ci.ub      
##  40.9733  0.4658  87.9712  <.0001  40.0604  41.8861  *** 
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## Test whether Region should be a random effect:
# Adds Region as a random effect to the null model structure.
Re_OA_mod <- rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_OA_AllData, 
                       random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                     ~1 |StudyID,
                                     ~1 |Region), 
                       sparse = TRUE,
                       data = data_OA, method = "ML")
summary(Re_OA_mod) #2837.3377

## Full model with fixed effects for Position, Breed, Region, and Class
OA_full_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_OA_AllData, 
                      mods = ~Position + Breed + Region + Class, 
                      random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                    ~1 |StudyID),
                      sparse = TRUE,
                      data = data_OA, method = "ML")
R2_Full <- round(r2_ml(OA_full_mod)*100, 2)
anova(OA_full_mod,null_OA_mod)
## 
##          df       AIC       BIC      AICc     logLik      LRT   pval          QE 
## Full    179 2820.3208 3560.5869 3048.8314 -1231.1604                  38363.1490 
## Reduced   3 2844.6020 2857.0087 2844.6544 -1419.3010 376.2812 <.0001 297114.6971
## Model with Position as a fixed effect
OA_Position_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_OA_AllData, 
                          mods = ~Position,
                          random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                        ~1 |StudyID),
                          sparse = TRUE,
                          data = data_OA, method = "ML")
R2_Position <-round(r2_ml(OA_Position_mod)*100, 2)
anova(OA_Position_mod,null_OA_mod)
## 
##         df       AIC       BIC      AICc     logLik    LRT   pval          QE 
## Full    13 2857.2435 2911.0058 2858.0560 -1415.6217               279902.5946 
## Reduced  3 2844.6020 2857.0087 2844.6544 -1419.3010 7.3586 0.6912 297114.6971
## Model with Breed as a fixed effect
OA_Breed_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_OA_AllData,

                                     ~1 |StudyID),
                       sparse = TRUE,

R2_Breed <- round(r2_ml(OA_Breed_mod)*100, 2)
anova(OA_Breed_mod,null_OA_mod)

## Model with Region as a fixed effect
OA_Region_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_OA_AllData,

R2_Region <- round(r2_ml(OA_Region_mod)*100, 2) 
anova(OA_Region_mod,null_OA_mod)

## Model with Class as a fixed effect
OA_Class_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_OA_AllData, 
                       mods = ~Class,

                                     ~1 |StudyID),
                       sparse = TRUE,

R2_Class <- round(r2_ml(OA_Class_mod)*100, 2)
anova(OA_Class_mod,null_OA_mod)
## 
##         df       AIC       BIC      AICc     logLik     LRT   pval          QE

## Reduced  3 2844.6020 2857.0087 2844.6544 -1419.3010 19.6246 0.1424 297114.6971
## Create a table of R-squared values for models with moderators
R2_models_summary <- data.frame("Model" = c("Full",
                                     "Position",
                                     "Breed",
                                     "Region", 
                                     "Class"),
                         "R2" = c(R2_Full[1],
                                  R2_Position[1],
                                  R2_Breed[1],
                                  R2_Region[1], 
                                  R2_Class[1]))
R2_models_summary <- R2_models_summary %>% 
  transmute(Model = Model
            ,R2= round(R2,2))

colnames(R2_models_summary)[2] <- "$R^2(\\%)$"

R2_models_summary %>% 
  kable(format="html", escape=F, caption="Heterogeneity explained in the models with moderators") %>% 
  collapse_rows(columns = 1, valign = "top") %>% 
  kable_styling(c("hover", "condensed"), full_width = F)

## Refit with REML for reporting in Manuscript
REML_OA_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_OA_AllData, 
                        random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                      ~1 |StudyID,
                                      ~1 |Region,
                                      # ~1 | Position, # Position was not better than null in initial test
                                      ~1 |Breed),
                        sparse = TRUE,
                        data = data_OA, method = "REML")
summary(REML_OA_mod)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 462; method: REML)
## 
##     logLik    Deviance         AIC         BIC        AICc   
## -1399.2238   2798.4476   2808.4476   2829.1146   2808.5795   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##              estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed   factor 
## sigma^2.1   6.2282  2.4956    462     no    RowID 
## sigma^2.2  32.5067  5.7015    222     no  StudyID 
## sigma^2.3  10.3612  3.2189     48     no   Region 
## sigma^2.4   5.8342  2.4154    124     no    Breed 
## 
## Test for Heterogeneity:
## Q(df = 461) = 297114.6971, p-val < .0001
## 
## Model Results:
## 
## estimate      se     zval    pval    ci.lb    ci.ub      
##  41.3420  0.7970  51.8727  <.0001  39.7799  42.9041  *** 
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
# Calculate I-squared values
round(i2_ml(REML_OA_mod), 2)
##   I2_Total   I2_RowID I2_StudyID  I2_Region   I2_Breed 
##      99.92      11.33      59.13      18.85      10.61
# Calculate R-squared
round(r2_ml(REML_OA_mod)*100, 2)
##    R2_marginal R2_conditional 
##           0.00          88.66
## Generate orchard plot for the REML model
p_REML_OA <- orchard_plot(REML_OA_mod,
                               group = "StudyID",  
                               xlab = "Mean Oleic Acid (%)", 
                               cb = FALSE,
                               angle = 0,
                               legend.pos = "bottom.out",
                               branch.size = 1.5)
print(p_REML_OA)

3 Meta-regression

3.1 Breed

## Filter data for breeds with at least 3 distinct StudyIDs
data_OA_B3 <- data_OA %>%
  group_by(Breed) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(StudyID) >= 3) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  as.data.frame()

## Create VCV matrix for the filtered breed data
VCV_OA_B3_Data <- make_VCV_matrix(data_OA_B3, 
                                   V = "rVar", 
                                   cluster = "StudyID", 
                                   obs = "RowID")
## Define random structure
random_structure_breed <- list(~1 |RowID,
                               ~1 |StudyID,
                               ~1 |Region) 

# Model with intercept
Br_VCV_REML_OA_mod_int <- rma.mv(
  yi = Mean,
  V = VCV_OA_B3_Data,
  mods = ~ Breed,
  random = random_structure_breed,
  test = "t",
  method = "REML",
  data = data_OA_B3)
summary(Br_VCV_REML_OA_mod_int)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 321; method: REML)
## 
##    logLik   Deviance        AIC        BIC       AICc

# Model without intercept for plotting
Br_VCV_REML_OA_mod <- rma.mv(
  yi = Mean,
  V = VCV_OA_B3_Data,
  mods = ~ Breed -1,

## Orchard plot for Breed moderator
p_Br_VCV_REML_OA <- orchard_plot(Br_VCV_REML_OA_mod,

## Generate table of pairwise comparisons for Breed using all_models function
res_OA_Br <- all_models(
  data        = data_OA_B3,

  yi_col      = "Mean",

3.2 Class

## Filter data for Class with at least 3 distinct StudyIDs
data_OA_Cl <- data_OA %>%
  group_by(Class) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(StudyID) >= 3) %>%

## Create VCV matrix for the filtered Class data

                                   V = "rVar",

                                   obs = "RowID")
## Define random structure
random_structure_class <- list(~1 |RowID,
                               ~1 |StudyID,
                               ~1 |Region, 
                               ~1 |Breed)
  
# Model with intercept

  yi = Mean,
  V = VCV_OA_Cl_Data,
  mods = ~ Class,
  random = random_structure_class,
  test = "t",
  method = "REML",

3.6 Age

## Filter data for complete cases of Age
data_OA_Age <- data_OA[complete.cases(data_OA$Age), ]

## Create VCV matrix for Age data
VCV_OA_Age_Data <- make_VCV_matrix(data_OA_Age, 
                                    V = "rVar", 
                                    cluster = "StudyID", 
                                    obs = "RowID")
## Define common random structure for continuous moderators
random_structure_continuous <- list(~1 |RowID,
                                    ~1 |StudyID,
                                    ~1 |Region,  
                                    ~1 |Breed)

## Run meta-regression for Age
res_OA_Age <- run_meta_ct(
  dat         = data_OA_Age,          
  mod_var     = "Age",
  random_list = random_structure_continuous, 
  plot_name   = "p_OA_Age",              
  x_lab       = "Age (Days)",
  y_lab       = "Mean Oleic Acid (%)" 
)

## Generate summary table for Age models
mods_list_age <- attr(res_OA_Age$best_model, "mods_list") 
aic_tab_age   <- res_OA_Age$aic_table                   

tbl_OA_Age <- model_summary_tbl(
  mods_list_age, aic_tab_age, 
  lin_coef  = "mod_c",              
  quad_coef = "mod_c2"
)
## Display summary table for Age models
html_table_age <- tbl_OA_Age %>% 
  kable(format = "html", digits = 4) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE, position = "left") %>%
  scroll_box(width = "100%", height = "400px")  
print(html_table_age)

4 Publication bias and sensitivity analyses

4.1 Decline effect (Publication Year)

## Define random structure
random_structure_Ye <- list(~1 |RowID,
                            ~1 |StudyID,
                            ~1 |Region,  
                            ~1 |Breed) 

## Model with Publication Year (Years) as moderator
Ye_VCV_REML_OA_mod_int <- rma.mv(
   yi = Mean,
   V = VCV_OA_AllData, 
   mods = ~ Years,
   random = random_structure_Ye, 
   test = "t",
   method = "REML",
   data = data_OA)
summary(Ye_VCV_REML_OA_mod_int)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 462; method: REML)
## 
##     logLik    Deviance         AIC         BIC        AICc   
## -1393.6402   2787.2803   2799.2803   2824.0677   2799.4658   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##              estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed   factor 
## sigma^2.1   6.2411  2.4982    462     no    RowID 
## sigma^2.2  31.9245  5.6502    222     no  StudyID 
## sigma^2.3  10.3028  3.2098     48     no   Region 
## sigma^2.4   5.7167  2.3910    124     no    Breed 
## 
## Test for Residual Heterogeneity:
## QE(df = 460) = 265876.2258, p-val < .0001
## 
## Test of Moderators (coefficient 2):
## F(df1 = 1, df2 = 460) = 4.9065, p-val = 0.0272
## 
## Model Results:
## 
##          estimate        se     tval   df    pval     ci.lb      ci.ub    
## intrcpt  718.9899  305.9287   2.3502  460  0.0192  117.7988  1320.1809  * 
## Years     -0.3356    0.1515  -2.2151  460  0.0272   -0.6333    -0.0379  * 
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
round(r2_ml(Ye_VCV_REML_OA_mod_int)*100, 2)
##    R2_marginal R2_conditional 
##           1.65          88.67
## Bubble plot for decline effect
p_Ye_VCV_REML_OA <- orchaRd::bubble_plot(Ye_VCV_REML_OA_mod_int, 
                                  mod = "Years",
                                  group = "StudyID",
                                  xlab = "Publication year",
                                  ylab = "Mean Oleic Acid (%)", 
                                  g = TRUE)
p_Ye_VCV_REML_OA <- p_Ye_VCV_REML_OA + scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2014, 2024, by = 2))
print(p_Ye_VCV_REML_OA)

4.2 Aim (Whether the aim of study was meat quality)

## Define random structure
random_structure_aim <- list(~1 |RowID,
                             ~1 |StudyID,
                             ~1 |Region,  
                             ~1 |Breed)

#Model with intercept
Ai_VCV_REML_OA_mod_int <- rma.mv(
   yi = Mean,
   V = VCV_OA_AllData, 
   mods = ~ Aim,
   random = random_structure_aim, 
   test = "t",
   method = "REML",
   data = data_OA)
summary(Ai_VCV_REML_OA_mod_int)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 462; method: REML)
## 
##     logLik    Deviance         AIC         BIC        AICc   
## -1395.1376   2790.2752   2802.2752   2827.0626   2802.4607   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##              estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed   factor 
## sigma^2.1   6.2203  2.4940    462     no    RowID 
## sigma^2.2  32.1137  5.6669    222     no  StudyID 
## sigma^2.3  10.9632  3.3111     48     no   Region 
## sigma^2.4   5.9392  2.4371    124     no    Breed 
## 
## Test for Residual Heterogeneity:
## QE(df = 460) = 296331.3152, p-val < .0001
## 
## Test of Moderators (coefficient 2):
## F(df1 = 1, df2 = 460) = 1.6187, p-val = 0.2039
## 
## Model Results:
## 
##          estimate      se     tval   df    pval    ci.lb    ci.ub      
## intrcpt   40.4094  1.0929  36.9750  460  <.0001  38.2617  42.5570  *** 
## AimYes     1.3669  1.0744   1.2723  460  0.2039  -0.7444   3.4783      
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
round(r2_ml(Ai_VCV_REML_OA_mod_int)*100, 2)
##    R2_marginal R2_conditional 
##           0.72          88.82
#Model without intercept for plotting
Ai_VCV_REML_OA_mod <- rma.mv(
   yi = Mean,
   V = VCV_OA_AllData, 
   mods = ~ Aim -1,
   random = random_structure_aim, 
   test = "t",
   method = "REML",
   data = data_OA)
## Orchard plot for Aim moderator
p_Ai_VCV_REML_OA <- orchard_plot(Ai_VCV_REML_OA_mod, 
                                   mod = "Aim",  
                                   group = "StudyID",  
                                   xlab = "Mean Oleic Acid (%)", 
                                   cb = FALSE,
                                   angle = 0,
                                   legend.pos = "bottom.out",
                                   branch.size = 1.5)
print(p_Ai_VCV_REML_OA)

##           0.29          88.80
#Model without intercept for plotting
Mu_VCV_REML_OA_mod <- rma.mv(
   yi = Mean,
   V = VCV_OA_AllData, 
   mods = ~ Multiple_breeds -1,
   random = random_structure_Mu, 
   test = "t",
   method = "REML",
   data = data_OA)
## Orchard plot for Multiple_breeds moderator
p_Mu_VCV_REML_OA <- orchard_plot(Mu_VCV_REML_OA_mod, 
                                   mod = "Multiple_breeds",  
                                   group = "StudyID",  
                                   xlab = "Mean Oleic Acid (%)", 
                                   cb = FALSE,
                                   angle = 0,
                                   legend.pos = "bottom.out",
                                   branch.size = 1.5)
print(p_Mu_VCV_REML_OA)
